explanation: The upstream job omitted the stipulated corpus record n06-r06 from both the needs and evidence_sources handoffs even though the review criteria require qualifying or fallback demand records to be selected while preserving record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight. Job 2 preserved the exact handoff it received and ranked its seven received records consistently, so the visible fault originates upstream before the downstream mapping and prioritization.

job_1 output needs omit n06-r06 and contain only n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08; metadata record_count is 7.
job_1 output evidence_sources also omit n06-r06 and metadata evidence_source_count is 7.
Produced handoffs show exact matching producer and consumer hashes for both needs and evidence_sources, and job_2 input contains the same seven-record handoffs.
job_2 capabilities include cap-compare for need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', but job_2 cannot map it because n06-r06 is absent from the upstream needs handoff.
The semantic declaration for select_demand says it selects demand records using the score threshold while keeping explicit fallback identifiers in the returned data path.
